messages.subject: figure margins too large?
parts:
Dear Karl,
I am confused, how to remove this error?.

> rf <- pull.rf(mapc) 

> lod <- pull.rf(mapc, what="lod")

> mn4 <- markernames(mapc, chr=4) 

> par(mfrow=c(2,1))

> plot(rf, mn4[3], bandcol="gray70", ylim=c(0,1), alternate.chrid=TRUE) 

Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: figure margins too large?
parts:
Your graphics device is too small for the plot you're trying to make. Try increasing the size of the R graphics window.
See for example https://stackoverflow.com/questions/12766166/error-in-plot-new-figure-margins-too-large-in-r

karl
